crossRefs.note: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all…
While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now…
The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread…
Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz…
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
Yahweh says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses…
We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.
If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’
Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

translations.web: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.
translations.bsb: All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. “No,” he said. “I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.” So his father wept for him.
translations.kjv: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept
translations.asv: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down to Sheol to my son mourning. And his father wept for him.
